scene.en: It's Monday, and your friend Kasia asks about your weekend. On Saturday you were at the cinema and saw a Polish film, which was very interesting. On Sunday you stayed at home: you slept and read. You haven't had dinner yet and you are hungry. You are a man, so you say byłem, czytałem; Kasia is a woman, and to her you say byłaś. She is your friend: to her you are ty.

replies.text: Świetnie! W sobotę byłem w kinie.

meaning.en: Great! On Saturday I was at the cinema.

acceptedAnswers: Świetnie! W sobotę byłem w kinie.
Świetnie, w sobotę byłem w kinie.

replies.text: Świetnie! W sobotę byłam w kinie.

meaning.en: Great! On Saturday I was at the cinema (a woman says it).

note.en: You are a man, so you say *byłem*. *Byłam* is what a woman says.

meaning.en: A Polish film. It was very interesting!
A Polish film. She was very interesting!

note.en: *Film* is masculine, so it is *film był ciekawy*.

turns.says: A w niedzielę? Byłeś na meczu?

meaning.en: And on Sunday? Were you at the match?

replies.text: Nie, byłem w domu. Spałem i czytałem.

meaning.en: No, I was at home. I slept and read.

acceptedAnswers: Nie, byłem w domu. Spałem i czytałem.
Nie, byłem w domu, spałem i czytałem.

meaning.en: Yes, I was at the match.

note.en: On Sunday you stayed at home: *nie, byłem w domu*.

turns.says: A ja byłam w górach! Nie miałam zasięgu.

meaning.en: And I was in the mountains! I had no signal.
You were in the mountains? How was it?

acceptedAnswers: Byłaś w górach? I jak było?

meaning.en: You were in the mountains? How was it? (to a man)

note.en: Kasia is a woman, so to her it is *byłaś*. *Byłeś* is for a man.

turns.says: Wspaniale! A ty jadłeś już obiad?

meaning.en: Wonderful! And have you had dinner yet?
I haven't eaten and I'm hungry!

acceptedAnswers: Nie, nie jadłem i jestem głodny!

meaning.en: Yes, I ate an hour ago.

note.en: You haven't eaten and you are hungry: *nie jadłem i jestem głodny!*

meaning.en: I haven't eaten and I'm hungry! (a woman says it)

note.en: You are a man: *nie jadłem*, *jestem głodny*.

meaning.en: Then come and have dinner with me, it's on me!
